title: Russia Launches Massive Attack on Ukraine Killing At Least 20; EU Condemns 'Strategy of Terror'
detail: Russia launched a massive missile and drone attack on Ukraine on October 7, 2026, killing at least 20 people. EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen condemned the strikes as part of Russia's 'strategy of terror' targeting Ukrainian civilians and infrastructure.

media.caption: Russia launches massive attack on Ukraine killing at least 20 people

title: Ukraine Strikes Russian Oil Tanker, Igniting Large Fire Off Black Sea Resort City
detail: Ukraine struck a Russian oil tanker off the coast of a Russian Black Sea resort city, causing a large fire and expanding the naval dimension of the conflict. The attack demonstrated Ukraine's continued ability to strike Russian maritime assets in the Black Sea.

title: Ukraine Accuses Russia of Bombing Civilian Apartment Block as 'Birthday Gift' for Putin
detail: Ukraine accused Russia of deliberately targeting a civilian apartment block as a symbolic 'birthday gift' for President Putin, highlighting the continued targeting of residential infrastructure. The strike underscored Russia's pattern of attacking civilian areas amid international condemnation.

media.caption: Ukraine accuses Russia of bombing apartment block as 'birthday gift' for Putin
